pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: Bubba G draftin' DR Congo like they were about to sneak-attack the tournament from the back door, and yet he's sittin' pretty at the top of the table. **France is comin' in strong, but Bubba better be careful Spain don't rain on his parade.** Meanwhile, Ghost Pepper's got Spain ready to spice things up in Arlington, but drafting Haiti like he was pickin' out exotic hot sauces might be puttin' some heat on his own roster. You gotta back yourself in these matchups, but I'm callin' it: France is gonna put Spain in the chili pot and stir the gumbo — 3-1 for Bubba G.
